title: A Tide for the Harbor
author: Lena Vane
blurb: Lena Okafor, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
